ui:help.en: The User-Agent header of every request to OpenAI (authorization, upstream, account test, token refresh, usage resets) of the accounts that set none of their own; an authorization uses the account form's value when it has one. Leave empty for the built-in sup2api-codex/<plugin version>.
ui:help.zh: 未自定义 User-Agent 的账号发往 OpenAI 的全部请求（授权、上游、账号测试、令牌刷新、用量重置）使用的 User-Agent 请求头；授权时账号表单里填了值就用表单的值。留空使用内置的 sup2api-codex/<插件版本>。

ui:help.en: The originator header of the same requests, for the accounts that set none of their own. Leave empty for the built-in sup2api.
ui:help.zh: 未自定义 originator 的账号在上述请求中使用的 originator 请求头。留空使用内置的 sup2api。
